to: new reserves no number, so two sessions are handed one id

A number is reserved only for the repository-scoped critical section from the cross-worktree scan through the exclusive task-file write. The mutex is released on success and on failure: a successful file permanently occupies the id through the source-of-truth task, while a session that dies or fails before writing burns no number after the stale mutex is recovered.
